captions: Tab. 3.8 Änderungen der Daten der Kategorie '10 Wärmedämmstoffe' (p.16)
reason: The cited Wyss 2014 KBOB update report is a change log: every table is 'Änderungen der Daten der Kategorie X' with the columns ID-Nummer / Baustoff / Änderung - a prose description of what changed relative to ecoinvent v2.2, no amounts. Tab. 3.8, the insulation-materials table, lists only three changes (PVC disposal dataset swapped, vermiculite and perlite newly added) and does not mention cellulose fibres. The report documents no inventory for any dataset.
